reviews.review_title: The game is worth your time and money!

This game is like gang beasts (I mean the game was heavily inspired of it) So, I think this game is worth your money and you should start playing it now.

It is honestly a really good game and I have a lot of fun playing it. It's really entertaining and a great VR game overall. The only problem I have with it is the climbing because it can be a little annoying sometimes and could be smoother. Other than that, the game is amazing and I definitely recommend it.

This is honestly one of the games I’ve been waiting for! I used to play gang beasts a lot with my friends, and some of my best memories came from that game. One of my friends has a vr so I can imagine already how many funny memories we’re going to make playing this game together. Alot of people love gang beasts because it's fun and can create a lot of moments. Now imagine experiencing all of that in vr. A lot of people have wanted something like this for a long time, including me. Bonelab fusion was one of the closest alternatives, but now we finally have an actual game for this kind of experience! I really appreciate what you’re doing with the game and I think it has a lot of potential. However, I have one suggestion that I believe would make the game even better please add a button that lets us slowly lift objects or other players, similar to how you can pick things up in gang beasts. This would make grabbing and lifting things feel much more natural, while also making it easier for players to interact with the environment and each other. Keep up the amazing work! I can’t wait to make some awesome memories with my friends in this game😁
